gold_sql: SELECT t.first_name, t.last_name, u.unit_number, u.monthly_rent FROM lease l JOIN lease_status s ON s.status_id=l.status_id JOIN tenant t ON t.tenant_id=l.tenant_id JOIN unit u ON u.unit_id=l.unit_id WHERE s.is_current=1

turns.say: Only tenants with a lease right now, with their unit and monthly rent

gold_sql: SELECT b.name, COUNT(*) FROM maintenance m JOIN unit u ON u.unit_id=m.unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id=u.building_id WHERE m.state <> 'closed' GROUP BY b.name

turns.say: How many are still open in each building?

gold_sql: SELECT m.request_id, m.category, s.first_name, s.last_name FROM maintenance m LEFT JOIN staff s ON s.staff_id=m.assigned_to WHERE m.priority='urgent' AND m.state <> 'closed'

turns.say: Urgent requests that are not closed, with the technician assigned

gold_sql: SELECT r.name, SUM(p.amount) FROM payment p JOIN lease l ON l.lease_id=p.lease_id JOIN unit u ON u.unit_id=l.unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id=u.building_id JOIN region r ON r.region_id=b.region_id WHERE p.paid_on >= '2026-01-01' AND p.paid_on < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY r.name
SELECT DISTINCT t.first_name, t.last_name FROM payment p JOIN lease l ON l.lease_id=p.lease_id JOIN tenant t ON t.tenant_id=l.tenant_id WHERE p.paid_on > p.due_on AND p.due_on >= '2026-01-01'

turns.say: Tenants who paid rent late at least once in 2026, just their names
